name: Teià (Spain)
description: White in the first two vertical thirds with the dark green spurge laurel of the arms at the centre, the last third yellow with four red pales.
history: The flag was approved on 26 May 2006 and published in the Diari Oficial de la Generalitat de Catalunya no. 4660 of 22 June 2006; it is based on the arms, an oblong flag of 2:3, white in the first two vertical thirds with the dark green spurge laurel of the arms at the centre, and the last third yellow with four red pales.

features.role: spurge laurel (matapoll) of the arms, 2/3 of the height
four red pales on yellow in the fly third
